name: Bulkhead door, round pressure hatch
brief: MK-035 Bulkhead door, round pressure hatch. Round 2, matched to the pick: a deep bezelled round hatch in a panelled wall, a big orange porthole in the middle of the door, a green door-state ring (green: the next module holds air; amber: cycling; red: stop), a chunky hinge on the left and latch dogs on the right, and a locking wheel.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
